lines.text: It is up. It looks incredible. I may cry. I am going to cry.
Repair first. The pylons hold. The arch is next spring. I can wait. I will complain while I wait.
A second path in the keystone. Nobody will see it. I will see it.

choice.text: Put your name on the keystone. It is yours.
Let it go unsigned. Like the best of them.

lines.text: Unsigned. That is the whole tradition, is it not. I hate it. I understand it.
